title.narrative: PRO - Local Governance for People and Nature in Serbia

description.narrative:
The PRO-Local Governance for People and Nature project aims to contribute to improving the well-being and quality of life of citizens through improved local governance, social inclusion and environmental protection in 99 cities and municipalities in two regions: Šumadija and Western Serbia, and Southern and Eastern Serbia. To achieve this objective the intervention will strengthen the capacities of local governments to manage the work of local governments with the application of the principles of good governance, develop evidence-based local policies of social inclusion and social protection, which will create a more responsible, integrative and innovative system of measures and services, and implement environmental protection governance in practice. 


Primary target groups are local governments, local administration and their specific departments, other relevant local public institutions, local CSOs and local citizens. Additionally, the main focus will be on left behind or at risk of being left behind groups: Roma, persons with disabilities, vulnerable women, older people, children and youth.

All programme activities will be implemented in close partnership and cooperation with key ministries, national and local institutions, coordinating the intervention with relevant national strategic, legislative and development documents.
